admin.intro: Each testimonial is reviewed before publication. Reject or remove any text that gives a health or disability detail, information about another person, or abusive language. You never see the author's account or who reported.
admin.problems: To fix before publication (the text cannot be edited: reject it with a reason)
admin.title: Testimonial moderation
closed: This feature is not open yet. It will open once its data protection impact assessment has been validated.
failed: The testimonials could not be loaded.
form.consent: I agree that this testimonial is published on the site under the first name or pseudonym given, after review. I can withdraw my agreement at any time: the testimonial is then removed from the site and its text erased.
form.health_warning: Do not give any detail about your health, a disability or a treatment, nor any information about other people (name, address, phone). It is not needed: a testimonial that contains such details is not published.
form.name: First name or pseudonym
form.name_help: This is the only name shown. Do not give your surname or your email address. One word, optionally followed by an initial (example: “Marie D.”).
form.no_photo: No photo or file: only the text and the first name or pseudonym are published.
form.sent: Thank you. Your testimonial will be reviewed before it is published. You can withdraw it at any time.
form.title: Write a testimonial
list.intro: People describe their experience of the service. Each testimonial is published with its author's agreement, after review, under the first name or pseudonym they chose. The author can withdraw it at any time.
list.notice: A testimonial tells a personal experience: every situation is different, and only the body concerned decides on yours.
list.title: Testimonials
mine.erased: The text of this testimonial has been erased.
mine.intro: Your testimonial is reviewed before publication. It is reserved for accounts of people aged 18 or over. You can withdraw it at any time.
mine.login_required: Sign in to write or withdraw a testimonial.
mine.one_active: You already have a testimonial pending or published. To write another one, withdraw it first.
mine.title: My testimonials
mine.withdraw_help: Withdrawal is immediate: the testimonial is no longer visible and its text is erased.
mine.withdrawn: Your testimonial is withdrawn and its text erased.
reason.personal_data: Personal data (a person's name, address, contact)
report.done: Thank you. The testimonial will be reviewed by the moderators.
report.login: To report a testimonial, sign in to your account: an account is needed to prevent abusive reports.
